growth_stage_source: General agronomy sources (LSU AgCenter, MAS Seeds, Bayer CropScience, Farmonaut, TNAU, ICAR-AICRP Small Millets summaries) — not a single ICAR/KVK document pulled per row this session, hence confidence=low throughout. See Phase 4 plan notes.

agronomic_rules.text: Rice is highly sensitive to water stress at panicle initiation — ensure standing water/irrigation within 1-2 days of reaching this stage to avoid yield loss.
agronomic_rules.source: General ICAR rice Package of Practices guidance — not pulled from a specific document this session.

agronomic_rules.text: Dead-heart incidence has crossed 5% — scout for yellow stem borer and consider need-based control per local KVK advisory.
agronomic_rules.source: Commonly cited Indian rice IPM ETL (5% dead hearts vegetative / 2% white ears reproductive) — not pulled from a specific ICAR/KVK document this session.

agronomic_rules.text: Finger millet is most vulnerable to moisture stress during seedling establishment — provide life-saving irrigation if available and no rainfall in the past 7 days.
agronomic_rules.source: General ICAR-AICRP Small Millets dryland guidance — not pulled from a specific document this session.

agronomic_rules.text: Warm humid conditions during flowering favor finger millet blast (neck blast) — scout earheads and consider prophylactic fungicide per local KVK advisory.
agronomic_rules.source: General ICAR-AICRP Small Millets blast-risk guidance — not a hard numeric threshold; genuinely needs local KVK sign-off before use.

agronomic_rules.text: Pink bollworm trap catch has crossed the ICAR-CICR economic threshold (8 moths/trap/night for 3 consecutive nights) — initiate control measures immediately.
agronomic_rules.source: ICAR-CICR (Central Institute for Cotton Research) published ETL — confirmed via web search against multiple corroborating sources.

agronomic_rules.text: Cotton water demand peaks from squaring through boll development — avoid moisture stress in this window.
agronomic_rules.source: General ICAR cotton Package of Practices guidance — not pulled from a specific document this session.

agronomic_rules.text: Grand growth phase is sugarcane's most water-sensitive period — irrigation deficit here has the largest yield impact of any stage.
agronomic_rules.source: General ICAR sugarcane Package of Practices guidance — not pulled from a specific document this session.

agronomic_rules.text: Early shoot borer dead-heart incidence has crossed 10% — scout and consider need-based control per local KVK advisory.
agronomic_rules.source: Commonly cited Indian sugarcane IPM ETL — sources disagree in the 5-10% range; not pulled from a specific document this session.

agronomic_rules.text: Fall armyworm whorl damage has crossed 5% of plants (ICAR-IIMR action threshold) — scout closely and consider need-based control.
agronomic_rules.source: ICAR-IIMR (2019)-cited action threshold — confirmed via web search; NOTE published literature ranges 5-30% across different sources/regions. Least settled number in this batch.

agronomic_rules.text: Maize is most drought-sensitive from tasseling through silking — a moisture deficit here causes the largest yield penalty of any growth stage.
agronomic_rules.source: General ICAR maize Package of Practices guidance (broadly and consistently published) — not pulled from a specific document this session.

govt_schemes.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

eligibility_criteria.land_holding: Cultivable land-holding farmer family (self/spouse/minor children), land registered in the farmer's name
exclusions: Government employees and pensioners (except Group D / Multi-Tasking Staff)
Licensed professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants, architects)

govt_schemes.benefit_description: ₹6,000/year, paid in three equal ₹2,000 installments via Direct Benefit Transfer to Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.

govt_schemes.authority: Department of Agriculture (KSDA), Government of Karnataka

eligibility_criteria.target: Dryland/rainfed farmers, primarily in low-and-medium-rainfall (450-850mm) taluks
eligibility_criteria.category_note: Subsidy tier depends on SC/ST vs. general category

govt_schemes.benefit_description: Subsidy (80–90% depending on category — exact current-year percentage is set by an annual circular; confirm at application_url before advising a farmer) for dryland water-conservation infrastructure: farm ponds (Krishi Honda), polyhouses, shade nets, lift irrigation, diesel pump sets.
